critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: LCP is 1288 ms desktop, 1156 ms tablet, and 308 ms mobile; FCP is 52–72 ms; load completes in 129–154 ms; and TTFB is 1.5–7.5 ms. No console, page, or request failures occurred, and no horizontal overflow was measured. Layout stability is excellent on desktop/mobile (CLS 0.0011/0), though tablet CLS reaches 0.0478. Animation sampling reports no long frames, but desktop averages 19.31 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame. Transfer cost is comparatively heavy at about 1.31 MB, dominated by 1.15 MB of JavaScript, across 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce and code-split the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload, then profile the desktop render path to keep typical frames under 16.7 ms. Reserve dimensions for the tablet elements responsible for the 0.0478 CLS.
